title: Implement ReLU
hint: ReLU(x) = max(0, x). Think about element-wise comparison with zero.

description.text: Implement the ReLU (rectified linear unit) activation: ReLU(x) = max(0, x) element-wise. Use basic PyTorch operations so gradients can flow during training.

examples.explanation: Negative values become 0; nonnegative values are unchanged.

constraints: Return a tensor with the same shape as x.
Do not use torch.relu, F.relu, or torch.clamp.
